violation_type.title: Exceptions for Immunization Requirements Must Meet Criteria Specified by DSHS (26 TAC §746.615(b))
violation_type.short_title: Exceptions for Immunization Requirements Must Meet Criteria Specified by DSHS
violation_type.typical_finding: One child enrolled in care had an expired  immunization exemption.

finding_variants.text: One child enrolled in care had an expired  immunization exemption.
The affidavit for immunizations did not meet the criteria for the required documentation.
The operation was not accepting children who are not vaccinated with an affidavit which is in violation with Texas Human Resources Code 42.043(d).
